title: Fans Nelson Rockefeller and Mrs. Ford
summary: Rockefeller and Mrs. Ford were fans who requested tunes.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: And one time Nelson Rockefeller was a great fan of mine. He was on a tour of his political speeches one time at the Garden City Hotel in Long Island and he walked all the way up, I was sitting on the bandstand high and he walked on to shake my hand, "Chief, I'm glad to see you. Play some good stuff for me," he says.
Another fan of mine, in Detroit, Mrs. Ford, Edsel Ford. She used to come and ---she's an elderly lady, always asked for-- "Chief, will you play "Basin Street Blues."
Everyone seems to like that, seems to be a big favorite.
